notes.title: Pull, Push, Control! ⚡ Casie’s Gravity Nexus Changes the Fight!
notes.notes:
Meet Casie, the Human Riftwalker — master of space and time, bending reality itself to control the battlefield.

With Temporal Shift, she rewinds her position, teleporting back to where she stood seconds before.

Her Surge Rebound releases a powerful wave of force, pushing enemies away and breaking their formation.

Through Swift Dash, Casie accelerates with incredible speed, outmaneuvering her foes and striking with precision.

And with Gravity Nexus, she unleashes her ultimate power — drawing all enemies into a single point, where escape is impossible.

On the battlefield, Casie is more than a fighter — she is the architect of combat itself, a manipulator of the time-space axis, and a Riftwalker who bends reality to her will.

Stay Epic, Stay Brave.

notes.title: Epic of Brave : Release
notes.notes:
🌟Unleash Your Legend: Epic of Brave!🌟

Calling all heroes! Are you ready to forge your destiny in a world of epic battles, strategic depth, and boundless customization? Then prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure with Epic of Brave, the exhilarating new MOBA that's now available on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840953/44c527509983b2132f25d65de43be886f6b30d6d.png

In Epic of Brave, you'll:

✨Dominate the Arena: Master the art of MOBA combat in thrilling 1v1 or 3v3 battles. Coordinate with your team, devise cunning strategies, and unleash devastating abilities to crush your opponents.

🗺️Craft Your Champion: Delve into a deep character creation system. Choose from a diverse roster of heroes, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Customize their appearance, hone their skills, and forge legendary weapons to suit your playstyle.

🏰Become a Master of Magic: Command a vast arsenal of potent spells. Combine different abilities to create devastating combos and dominate the battlefield. Experiment and discover the perfect build to lead your team to victory.

🔥Experience the Campaign: Embark on a captivating narrative alongside your fellow heroes. Unravel the mysteries of the world, complete challenging quests, and earn valuable rewards to empower your champions.

Epic of Brave offers:

🎉Fast-Paced Action: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping thrill of MOBA combat.

🔮Strategic Depth: Devise cunning tactics, outmaneuver your opponents, and claim victory through superior strategy.

👉Endless Customization: Forge your legend with a vast array of character options, weapons, and abilities.

🛡️A Thriving Community: Join a passionate community of players and forge lasting friendships on the battlefield.

Ready to answer the call? Download Epic of Brave on Steam today and write your own epic saga!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840953/2cad92128b95f05a448bcf1b68467224697404de.jpg

We're incredibly excited to welcome you to the world of Epic of Brave. Your feedback during this Early Access phase is invaluable to us as we continue to refine and expand the game. Together, let's create a MOBA experience that stands the test of time.

Thank you for your support, and see you on the battlefield!

— The Epic of Brave Team
